title: Spatial Reasoning via Modality Switching Between Language and Symbolic Representations
abstract: arXiv:2606.31285v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Human reasoning is inherently multimodal: when problems become difficult, we rarely think in words alone. We often externalize our reasoning by sketching diagrams or drawing grids to understand the underlying conceptual structure and avoid mistakes. Building on this premise, our research investigates: (a) whether grounding multi-hop textual-spatial stories into geometry-aware modalities, such as layouts or grids, improves reasoning compared to natural language-based inference; and (b) whether a model can decide when to rely on natural language reasoning and when to switch to a structured modality. We address these questions by introducing a switching metric based on trustworthiness and complexity signals, which estimates when grounding a spatial story into structure is likely to improve performance. translated_title: 通过语言与符号表示之间的模态切换实现空间推理
translated_abstract: 人类的推理本质上是多模态的：当问题变得困难时，我们很少仅用文字来思考。我们常常通过勾勒图表或绘制网格来外化推理过程，以理解潜在的概念结构并避免错误。基于这一前提，我们的研究探讨以下两个问题：(a) 将多跳文本-空间故事锚定到具有几何感知能力的模态（如布局或网格）中，是否比基于自然语言的推理更能提升推理效果；(b) 模型能否自行决定何时应依赖自然语言推理，何时应切换到结构化模态。我们通过引入一种基于可信度与复杂度信号的切换指标来解决这些问题，该指标用于估计何时将空间故事锚定到结构化表示中可能提升性能。这是朝着大型语言模型（LLM）推理中原则性模态选择迈出的第一步。在我们的各项实验设置中，从自然语言切换到……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于可信度和复杂度信号的切换指标，使大语言模型能够自主判断何时将空间故事文本锚定到布局、网格等几何结构化模态中，从而提升多跳空间推理性能，迈出了LLM推理中原则性模态选择的第一步。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a switching metric based on trustworthiness and complexity signals that enables LLMs to decide when to ground textual-spatial stories into structured geometric modalities such as layouts or grids, improving multi-hop spatial reasoning and taking a first step toward principled modality selection in LLM reasoning.
